SabrinaIntroText:
SABRINA: I knew
you were coming…

Three years ago I
had a vision of your arrival.

You're after my
BADGE.

I don't enjoy bat-
tling, but it's my

duty as a LEADER
to confer BADGES

on anyone who has
proven him- or herself worthy.

Since you wish it,
I will show you my psychic powers!
SabrinaWinLossText:
SABRINA: Your
power…

It far exceeds
what I foresaw…

Maybe it isn't
possible to fully

predict what the
future holds…

OK, you win. You
earned yourself MARSHBADGE.
SabrinaMarshBadgeText:
SABRINA: MARSH-
BADGE draws out

your subliminal
powers…

Although I failed
to accurately pre- dict your power, this much I know to be true.

You will become a
celebrated and beloved CHAMPION!
SabrinaFightDoneText:
SABRINA: Your love
for your #MON

overwhelmed my
psychic power…

The power of love,
I think, is also a

kind of psychic
power…
MediumRebeccaSeenText:
The power of all
those you defeated comes to me!
MediumRebeccaAfterBattleText:
What is the source
of your power?
PsychicFranklinSeenText:
Psychic power is
the power of your soul.
PsychicFranklinBeatenText:
Your soul has more
power than mine!
PsychicFranklinAfterBattleText:
You made your soul
stronger, not just your abilities.
MediumDorisSeenText:
Fufufufu…
I see it clearly.

I can see into
your soul!
MediumDorisBeatenText:
Though I read you,
I still lost…
MediumDorisAfterBattleText:
Darn! I forgot
that I predicted I would lose to you.
PsychicJaredSeenText:
The FIGHTING DOJO
next door was once this city's GYM.
PsychicJaredAfterBattleText:
KARATE KING, the
master of the

FIGHTING DOJO, was
just destroyed by SABRINA.
SaffronGymGuideText:
Yo, CHAMP in
making!

A trainer as
skilled as you

doesn't need to be
told how to deal

with psychic-type
#MON, right?

I expect great
things from you!

Good luck!
